description: This file defines the `ModuleHolder` template class for managing nn::Module subclasses, along with macros for module creation. It includes template implementations, serialization operators, and utility macros, serving as an internal implementation detail for the PyTorch C++ API.

classes.name: ModuleHolder
classes.description: A wrapper around std::shared_ptr for nn::Module subclasses, providing constructors, accessors, and forwarding methods.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Calls the forward() method of the contained module with forwarded arguments.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses the contained module via subscript operator.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the ModuleHolder contains a module.
